Keeps the original LockGlyphTime 1.1.4 runtime and all clock/date, four-frame photo/sticker, sizing, positioning, fonts, colors and shadow features, while adding an exact-result transparency cache to stop repeated full-image CoreGraphics/vImage alpha scans during layout.

files.name: Next Post 1.0.7 LevelPlay Guide Complete
files.notes: Aligns Next Post with Unity LevelPlay iOS setup guidance: official Swift Package integration, -ObjC, z/sqlite3 and required Apple frameworks, ironSource SKAdNetwork ID, Universal SKAN postback endpoint, ATS settings, corrected banner/interstitial IDs, and existing native LevelPlay initialization.

files.name: Next Post 1.0.6 Test Device ID
files.notes: Adds an in-app LevelPlay test-device helper. Tap Test ID, grant Apple tracking permission, copy the iPhone Advertising ID (IDFA), and paste it into LevelPlay Setup > Test devices. Keeps the corrected banner ID and native LevelPlay integration.

files.name: Next Post 1.0.5 Banner ID Fix
files.notes: Fixes the LevelPlay banner Ad Unit ID transcription error. The verified dashboard Banner ID is 3enr810rqws9op9z (digit 1), not 3enr8l0rqws9op9z (letter l). Keeps the verified interstitial ID y23pc99ate029uga and the full native LevelPlay SDK integration from 1.0.4.

files.name: Next Post 1.0.4 LevelPlay Proper
files.notes: Proper native Unity LevelPlay integration using the official Swift Package. Includes the configured Next Post app key, adaptive bottom banner, frequency-limited interstitial after five successful generations, ATS/SKAdNetwork/privacy configuration, adapter debug logging for device testing, and retains the article-specific X preview fix. Live ads still depend on LevelPlay account approval; configure this iPhone as a LevelPlay test device to force test inventory while approval is pending.

files.name: Module Glass Preview 1.0.0
files.notes: Live companion app for Module Glass Stable Recovery. Provides Control Center preview, Device Live preference/image changes, Darwin reload notifications, and direct Module Glass log viewing.

files.name: Next Post 1.0.3 Article Preview Fix
files.notes: Fixes X/Twitter link cards so generated posts request the article-specific preview instead of the generic Next Solution image. Uses a cache-busting social share URL while keeping the clean canonical article route. Ads are not included in this build.

files.name: Next Post 1.0.2 LevelPlay Diagnostic
files.notes: LevelPlay diagnostic build. Enables Unity’s official iOS integration test suite before SDK init, adds the required ATS network configuration, and exposes LevelPlay initialization/load errors instead of silently ignoring them. Use this build to verify test ad delivery while the account is pending approval.

files.name: Next Signer 1.1.2
files.notes: Fixes false signing failure on apps such as Ksign. Uses Zsign signing success plus signed-bundle validation instead of the unreliable Zsign Mach-O checkSigned result. Keeps local P12 + mobileprovision signing, export, and publish-after-sign flow.

files.name: Next Post 1.0.1 LevelPlay Test
files.notes: Test build with Unity LevelPlay monetization integration: adaptive bottom banner plus frequency-limited interstitial after five successful post generations. Ad loading remains non-blocking while the LevelPlay account is pending approval.

files.name: Next Post 1.0.0
files.notes: Next Solution X post generator. Pulls automated articles from nextsolution.cc, generates non-repeating X-ready posts with article link, SEO-focused descriptions and hashtags, supports copy, Open in X, source article access, and persistent generated-post counters.
